index_only_probe.known_limits: This verifies cache acquisition and APT authentication, not full agent/verifier image construction. Two earlier local probe invocations stopped on unsupported tmpfs ownership syntax and a locked system APT state directory; the passing probe uses fresh unprivileged scratch state.

diagnosis: Main and security compressed index bytes exist and match signed-release identities. Gzip/plain delivery returned 503/504. The pinned base compression configuration did not establish a configuration defect; flaky remote delivery is the supported finding.
correction: Existing helper caches the exact dated InRelease and Packages.xz bytes with at most three transport attempts per request. All APT build phases use a temporary file source with the existing signed-by keyring; snapshot-selected package size/SHA256 and apt --no-download stay enforced. Runtime sources, snapshot date, versions and base digest remain unchanged.
